sentences.en: Hey there, Shankar here.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是 Shankar。

sentences.en: One of the rewarding aspects of our work at Hidden Brain is that we
sentences.zh: 在《Hidden Brain》节目中，我们工作中最有意义的一点在于，

sentences.en: have the space to experiment with different ways of telling stories.
sentences.zh: 我们有空间去尝试不同的叙事方式。

sentences.en: Sometimes we need an hour-long
sentences.zh: 有时我们需要一个小时的

sentences.en: podcast to fully explore a topic.
sentences.zh: 播客来充分探讨一个话题。

sentences.en: Other times, a short episode can convey our thinking.
sentences.zh: 而有时，一集短片就能传达我们的想法。

sentences.en: Today's show is a short essay about one thing our minds do as we confront the COVID-19 pandemic.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目是一篇短文，讲述了我们在面对新冠疫情时，大脑会产生的一种反应。

sentences.en: Over the past few weeks, our TVs have become a time machine.
sentences.zh: 过去几周里，我们的电视机仿佛变成了一台时间机器。

sentences.en: They've transported us to our past,
sentences.zh: 它们把我们带回了过去，

sentences.en: to scenes of crowded subway cars and chaotic playgrounds, where faces are unmasked and people
sentences.zh: 带回了那些拥挤的地铁车厢和喧闹的游乐场，那里的人们没有戴口罩，

sentences.en: sit shoulder to shoulder in sports stadiuMs. I have found myself marveling at movies where
sentences.zh: 在体育场里肩并肩坐着。我发现自己惊叹于那些电影，

sentences.en: carefree characters hang out at music clubs.
sentences.zh: 电影里无忧无虑的角色在音乐俱乐部里消磨时光。

sentences.en: It makes me remember a time when I didn't have to
sentences.zh: 这让我怀念起那个时候，那时我不需要

sentences.en: think twice about hugging a friend or stopping by a cafe with a colleague.
sentences.zh: 多想就能拥抱朋友，或者和同事去咖啡馆坐坐。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine
sentences.zh: 很难想象

sentences.en: being so carefree again, even as many communities in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 还能再次那样无忧无虑，即使现在美国

sentences.en: and across the globe make tentative steps
sentences.zh: 乃至全球的许多社区都在尝试

sentences.en: to reopen.
sentences.zh: 重新开放。

sentences.en: The ache we feel for a pre-COVID world may seem unproductive.
sentences.zh: 我们对疫情前世界的渴望似乎显得毫无意义。

sentences.en: What's the value in looking
sentences.zh: 回顾那些失去的自由和舒适，

sentences.en: back at lost freedoms and comforts?
sentences.zh: 又有什么价值呢？

sentences.en: Why focus on things we cannot change?
sentences.zh: 为什么要把注意力放在我们无法改变的事情上？

sentences.en: Of course, this is how the
sentences.zh: 当然，这就是大脑

sentences.en: mind works.
sentences.zh: 运作的方式。

sentences.en: Some time ago, I was chatting with Clay Rutledge, a psychologist at North Dakota State
sentences.zh: 不久前，我与北达科他州立大学的心理学家 Clay Rutledge 聊天，

sentences.en: University, for a Hidden Brain episode called The Good Old Days.
sentences.zh: 那是为了《Hidden Brain》一期名为《往日美好时光》的节目。

sentences.en: Clay studies nostalgia and how it
sentences.zh: Clay 研究怀旧心理，以及它如何

sentences.en: affects the way we think about our lives.
sentences.zh: 影响我们看待生活的方式。

sentences.en: Many of us experience nostalgia as a bittersweet emotion.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人将怀旧视为一种苦乐参半的情绪。

sentences.en: It combines the memory of good times with the ache of loss.
sentences.zh: 它结合了对美好时光的记忆和失去的痛苦。

sentences.en: You might think that people who are very
sentences.zh: 你可能认为那些非常

sentences.en: nostalgic are more prone to sadness and depression.
sentences.zh: 怀旧的人更容易感到悲伤和抑郁。

sentences.en: But Clay found that nostalgic reflection actually
sentences.zh: 但 Clay 发现，怀旧的沉思实际上

sentences.en: makes us optimistic.
sentences.zh: 让我们变得乐观。

sentences.en: It reaffirms our social connections.
sentences.zh: 它重申了我们的社会联系。

sentences.en: And by remembering important things
sentences.zh: 通过铭记过去的重要事物，

sentences.en: about the past, it lays out a hopeful vision for the future.
sentences.zh: 它为未来描绘了一幅充满希望的愿景。

sentences.en: I found in recent weeks that my own mind
sentences.zh: 我发现最近几周，我自己的思绪

sentences.en: is going back further and further, sometimes to my distant childhood.
sentences.zh: 越飘越远，有时甚至回到了遥远的童年。

sentences.en: Last week, I cooked a recipe I
sentences.zh: 上周，我做了一道菜，

sentences.en: learned decades ago from a long-dead aunt.
sentences.zh: 那是几十年前从一位早已过世的姑姑那里学来的。

sentences.en: I remembered how, after placing food before me,
sentences.zh: 我记得她把食物端到我面前后，

sentences.en: she always thought to place some food on her windowsill for birds to eat.
sentences.zh: 总是会记得在窗台上放些食物给鸟儿吃。

sentences.en: When we remember people who have
sentences.zh: 当我们怀念那些

sentences.en: been kind to us, when we remember happy times, we're not merely engaging in fantasy.
sentences.zh: 曾经善待我们的人，怀念快乐的时光时，我们不仅仅是在幻想。

sentences.en: We're reminding
sentences.zh: 我们是在提醒

sentences.en: ourselves of our place in the world.
sentences.zh: 自己在这个世界上的位置。

sentences.en: Nostalgia can give us renewed appreciation for the people and places
sentences.zh: 怀旧可以让我们重新审视那些构成我们生活的人和地方，

sentences.en: that constitute our lives.
sentences.zh: 并心存感激。

sentences.en: A number of years ago, Clay surveyed a group of adults in Britain who had
sentences.zh: 几年前，Clay 调查了一群在英国长大、

sentences.en: been children during World War II.
sentences.zh: 经历过二战的成年人。

sentences.en: The war was a time of great upheaval for them as their country was
sentences.zh: 战争对他们来说是一个动荡的时期，因为他们的国家

sentences.en: bombed and family members were sent off to the battlefront.
sentences.zh: 遭到轰炸，家人被送往战场。

sentences.en: But these people didn't remember the
sentences.zh: 但这些人并没有带着恐惧

sentences.en: period with horror.
sentences.zh: 回忆那段时期。

sentences.en: They remembered it with nostalgia.
sentences.zh: 他们带着怀旧之情回忆起那段时光。

sentences.en: They told Clay that it was a time of deep distress,
sentences.zh: 他们告诉 Clay，那是一段深陷苦难的时期，

sentences.en: but it was also a moment of profound meaning.
sentences.zh: 但也是一个具有深远意义的时刻。

sentences.en: It revealed to them what was truly important in their
sentences.zh: 它向他们揭示了生命中真正重要的东西，

sentences.en: lives, their connections to other people.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们与他人的联系。

sentences.en: There was so much movement, so much upheaval, one person told
sentences.zh: “当时有太多的变动，太多的动荡，”一个人告诉

sentences.en: Clay, yet through it all, there's a strong sense of belonging, of security, of family.
sentences.zh: Clay，“但尽管如此，依然有一种强烈的归属感、安全感和家庭感。”

sentences.en: Perhaps you
sentences.zh: 也许你

sentences.en: understand this yourself.
sentences.zh: 自己也能理解这一点。

sentences.en: One thing many of us have realized these past few months is how much we value
sentences.zh: 过去几个月里，我们许多人意识到的一件事是，我们有多么珍视

sentences.en: the people in our lives.
sentences.zh: 生命中的那些人。

sentences.en: Maybe you've had a Zoom happy hour with friends you haven't seen in years.
sentences.zh: 也许你和多年未见的朋友进行过 Zoom 欢乐时光。

sentences.en: Maybe you've taken long walks with family and noticed new things about your community.
sentences.zh: 也许你和家人散过长步，并发现了社区里的新事物。

sentences.en: Maybe you found yourself just sitting and doing nothing and connecting with yourself.
sentences.zh: 也许你发现自己只是坐着，什么也不做，与自己进行连接。

sentences.en: For those of us
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些

sentences.en: who lead frenetic lives, all these can be novel experiences.
sentences.zh: 生活节奏极快的人来说，所有这些都可能是新奇的体验。

sentences.en: One useful exercise to practice in
sentences.zh: 在当下，一个有用的练习是

sentences.en: these times is to close your eyes and ask yourself what you will feel nostalgic about when you look back
sentences.zh: 闭上眼睛，问问自己，当你回顾 2020 年初的几个月时，你会怀念什么。

sentences.en: on the early months of 2020.
sentences.zh: 你会为什么而微笑？

sentences.en: What will you smile about?

sentences.en: What will you miss?
sentences.zh: 通过未来自己的视角来思考现在，
